Title: Visit log for one of my companies
Steps: 1. take a company id from `companylist` 2. POST `getlastvisitedentry` with it
Expected result: HTTP 200; `status` 1 with `data` (latest entry) and `list` (all entries), or `status` 0 "Sorry, Visited entry not found."

Title: Another user's visit log is not returned (S3.8)
Preconditions: Business Sales Agent company ids are readable by that user
Steps: 1. read a company id as the Business Sales Agent 2. POST `getlastvisitedentry` with that id **as the Sales Agent**
Expected result: no visit entries for a company the caller does not own. **Code has no owner filter**, so entries may be returned (known gap UI-SEC-10)
